content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Usdt payment

A USDT payment gateway for digital products is a self-hosted system that verifies crypto payments and delivers files automatically. Unlike platforms like Gumroad (10% fee) or PayPal (restricted in many regions), this architecture uses open tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. You control the entire stack. Payments settle directly to your wallet. File delivery triggers instantly on-chain. The system runs without ongoing fees or third-party dependencies. This matters because it eliminates platform rejection, retains more revenue, and gives you full ownership of your commerce infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core components are: 1) A static site (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages) for your storefront, 2) Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, 3) Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders, 4) NOWPayments to verify USDT transactions, and 5) Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver files. When a buyer sends USDT, NOWPayments confirms the payment on-chain. The webhook triggers the backend script, which checks the order, marks it as paid, and sends the download link. No manual intervention required. The buyer gets their product instantly. You keep 99.5% of the sale.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software and cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, this architecture solves your problem. It’s also for creators who want to avoid platform fees. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad (10% fee) to NOWPayments (0.5%) retains $921 more in revenue. This is not a workaround—it’s a permanent, sovereign solution.
Retain 99.5% of every sale by switching from Gumroad (10% fee) to NOWPayments (0.5%).
The Components That Make It Work Together

1) **Frontend**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your product pages for free. 2) **Backend**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification and file delivery logic. 3) **Database**: Supabase or Google Sheets stores order details. 4) **Payment Processor**: NOWPayments verifies USDT payments with a 0.5% fee. 5) **File Storage**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your digital products. 6) **Webhook Integration**: NOWPayments sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms. Each component is free or low-cost, and you own the entire stack after deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack: GitHub Pages + Apps Script for simplicity, or Cloudflare Pages + Workers for scalability. Set up NOWPayments to accept USDT on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees (under $0.10). Configure the backend script to listen for NOWPayments webhooks and deliver files automatically. Load your products into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test end-to-end before going live. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates to deploy this in 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for USDT transactions. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions and fees. When a buyer sends USDT, NOWPayments verifies the payment and triggers file delivery automatically. You retain full control and 99.5% of each sale. The system works for any digital product, from ebooks to templates.

If you’re selling notion templates, fonts, or digital downloads and want to accept crypto without platform fees, the architecture described here applies directly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates to deploy this system for any product type. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to download instantly.
Your Deployment Checklist

1) Choose your stack: GitHub Pages + Apps Script for simplicity, or Cloudflare Pages + Workers for scalability. 2) Set up NOWPayments to accept USDT on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 3) Configure the backend script to listen for NOWPayments webhooks and deliver files automatically. 4) Load your products into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5) Test end-to-end before going live. 6) Deploy your storefront and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system to sell software or plugins?

Yes. The architecture works for any digital product. Simply upload your software or plugin files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and configure the backend script to deliver them after payment verification.
What if USDT prices fluctuate against USD?
NOWPayments converts USDT to USD at the time of transaction, locking in the price for both you and the buyer. This eliminates currency risk.
Do I need to know how to code to deploy this?

Basic technical skills are required, but the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes templates and blueprints to simplify deployment. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script use JavaScript, a widely supported language.
Can I accept other cryptocurrencies besides USDT?
Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. You can configure your store to accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, or any other coin NOWPayments supports.
What happens if a payment fails or the buyer disputes it?
NOWPayments handles payment verification on-chain. If a payment fails, the buyer cannot access the product. Disputes are rare with crypto transactions, as they are irreversible by design.
Accept USDT on low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transactions under $0.10.
